subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar e (re)produzir, em cantiga, quadras, quadrinhas, parlendas, trava-línguas e canções, rimas, aliterações, assonâncias, o ritmo de fala relacionado ao ritmo e à melodia das músicas e seus efeitos de sentido.

components.description_pt: Identificar instâncias de rima em cantigas, quadrinhas, cantigas de ninar, parlendas e músicas
components.description_en: Identify instances of rhyme in cantigas, quatrains, nursery rhymes, tongue-twisters, and songs
components.cc_component_description: Identify sound devices such as alliteration and rhyme in a story, poem, or song

components.description_pt: Identificar instâncias de aliteração e assonância em textos versificados e musicais
components.description_en: Identify instances of alliteration and assonance in versified and musical texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify sound devices such as alliteration and rhyme in a story, poem, or song

components.description_pt: Relacionar o ritmo da fala ao ritmo e à melodia da música em textos versificados
components.description_en: Connect speech rhythm to the rhythm and melody of music in versified texts
components.cc_component_description: Describe how rhythm created by beats or repeated lines contributes to meaning in a poem or song

components.description_pt: Analisar os efeitos de rima, aliteração e assonância no sentido de um texto
components.description_en: Analyze the effects of rhyme, alliteration, and assonance on the meaning of a text
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the impact of rhyme on the meaning or effect of a specific poem or stanza

cc_matches.description: Describe how words and phrases (e.g., regular beats, alliteration, rhymes, repeated lines) supply rhythm and meaning in a story, poem, or song.

Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, including figurative and connotative meanings; analyze the impact of rhymes and other repetitions of sounds (e.g., alliteration) on a specific verse or stanza of a poem or section of a story or drama.
